name: Diblathaim
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.
notes: Diblathaim, also known as Almon-diblathaim or Beth-diblathaim, was a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.

name: Dibon
meaning: A city in Judah, inhabited by the tribe of Judah.
notes: Dibon, a city in Judah, was inhabited by the tribe of Judah after the Babylonian exile ( Nehemiah 11:25 ).

name: Dibon
meaning: Moabite city, allotted to Gad, later possessed by Moab.
notes: Dibon, also known as Dibon-gad, was a Moabite city allotted to the tribe of Gad, later repossessed by Moab.

name: Dilean
meaning: A city in the lowlands of Judah.
notes: Dilean, a city located in the lowlands of Judah ( Joshua 15:38 ).

name: Dimnah
meaning: A Levitical city in the territory of Zebulun.
notes: Dimnah, also known as Rimmon or Rimmono, was a Levitical city in the territory of Zebulun.

name: Dimonah
meaning: A city in the Negev region of Judah.
notes: Dimonah, a city located in the Negev region of Judah ( Joshua 15:22 ).

name: Dinhabah
meaning: The capital city of Edom during Bela's reign.
notes: Dinhabah, the capital city of Edom during the reign of King Bela ( Genesis 36:32; 1Ch.1.43 ).

name: Diviners'_Oak
meaning: A tree near Shechem, associated with pagan divination practices.
notes: The Diviners' Oak was a tree near Shechem, likely associated with pagan divination practices ( Judges 9:37 ).

name: Dizahab
meaning: A place near where Moses delivered his final speeches.
notes: Dizahab, a place near where Moses delivered his final speeches to the Israelites ( Deu.1.1 ).

name: Dophkah
meaning: A place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings.
notes: Dophkah, a place where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings after leaving Egypt ( Numbers 33:12-13 ).

name: Dor
meaning: A Canaanite city, later allotted to Manasseh but not conquered.
notes: Dor, also known as Naphath-dor, was a Canaanite city allotted to Manasseh but not fully conquered ( Joshua 12:23; 17:11; Judges 1:27 ).

name: Dothan
meaning: A place where Joseph found his brothers and was sold.
notes: Dothan, a place where Joseph found his brothers and was later sold into slavery ( Genesis 37:17 ).

name: Dragon_Spring
meaning: A water source near Jerusalem, mentioned in Nehemiah's wall inspection.
notes: The Dragon Spring was a water source near Jerusalem, mentioned during Nehemiah's inspection of the city walls ( Nehemiah 2:13 ).

name: Dumah
meaning: A city or region in Arabia, recipient of a prophetic oracle.
notes: Dumah, a city or region in Arabia, was the recipient of a prophetic oracle in Isaiah 21:11 .

name: Dumah
meaning: A city in the hill country of Judah.
notes: Dumah, a city located in the hill country of Judah ( Joshua 15:52 ).

name: Dung_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, possibly used for waste removal.
notes: The Dung Gate was one of the gates in Jerusalem's wall, possibly used for removing waste from the city ( Nehemiah 2:13; 3:13-14; 12:31 ).

name: Dura
meaning: A plain in Babylon where Nebuchadnezzar set up a statue.
notes: Dura, a plain in the province of Babylon where King Nebuchadnezzar set up a golden statue ( Dan.3.1 ).

name: East
meaning: A direction associated with invading armies and nomadic tribes.
notes: In the Bible, the East is often associated with invading armies and nomadic tribes ( Judges 6:3, 33; 7:12; 8:10; Ezk.25.4, 10 ).

name: East_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, near the house of Shemaiah.
notes: The East Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, located near the house of Shemaiah ( Nehemiah 3:29 ).

name: Ebal_Mount
meaning: A mountain in Canaan, site of curses and blessings ceremony.
notes: Mount Ebal, also known as Mount Zalmon or Mount Ephraim, was a mountain in Canaan where the Israelites held a ceremony of curses and blessings ( Deu.11.29; 27:4, 13; Joshua 8:30, 33; Judges 9:48; Psalm 68:14; Jeremiah 4:15 ).

name: Ebenezer
meaning: A stone memorial set up by Samuel to commemorate victory.
notes: Ebenezer was a stone memorial set up by Samuel to commemorate Israel's victory over the Philistines ( 1Sa.4.1; 5:1; 7:12 ).

name: Ebez
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Issachar.
notes: Ebez was a town allotted to the tribe of Issachar ( Joshua 19:20 ).

name: Ecbatana
meaning: A city in Media where a significant scroll was found.
notes: Ecbatana was a city in Media where a scroll was found containing a decree by King Cyrus ( Ezra 6:2 ).

name: Eden
meaning: A city or region, possibly in Mesopotamia or Syria.
notes: Eden, a city or region mentioned in the Old Testament, possibly located in Mesopotamia or Syria ( 2Ki.19.12; Isaiah 37:12; Ezk.27.23 ).

name: Eden
meaning: The perfect garden where God placed Adam and Eve.
notes: Eden, the perfect garden created by God, where He placed Adam and Eve ( Genesis 2:8, 10, 15; 3:23-24; 4:16; Isaiah 51:3; Ezk.28.13; 31:9, 16, 18; 36:35; Jol.2.3 ).

name: Eder
meaning: A town in the Negev region of Judah.
notes: Eder, a town located in the Negev region of Judah ( Joshua 15:21 ).

name: Edom
meaning: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel
notes: Edom, a nation descended from Esau that was often in conflict with Israel.

name: Edrei
meaning: Amorite city defeated by Moses and the Israelites
notes: Edrei, an Amorite city east of the Jordan defeated by the Israelites under Moses.

name: Eglaim
meaning: Moabite city; its destruction prophesied by Isaiah
notes: Eglaim, a Moabite city whose destruction was prophesied by Isaiah.

name: Eglath-shelishiyah
meaning: Moabite city; its destruction prophesied by Isaiah and Jeremiah
notes: Eglath-shelishiyah, a Moabite city whose destruction was prophesied by Isaiah and Jeremiah.

name: Eglon
meaning: Amorite king of Lachish; city in Judah
notes: Eglon, an Amorite king of Lachish defeated by Joshua, also a city in Judah.

name: Egypt
meaning: Ancient nation; Israelites enslaved there; plagues and Exodus
notes: Egypt, a powerful nation where the Israelites were enslaved until God delivered them in the Exodus.

name: Egypt_Sea
meaning: Likely the Gulf of Suez, part of the Red Sea
notes: The Egypt Sea, probably referring to the Gulf of Suez, an arm of the Red Sea.

name: Ekron
meaning: One of the five major Philistine city-states
notes: Ekron, one of the five principal Philistine cities, located in southwestern Canaan.

name: Elah_Valley
meaning: Site of David's victory over Goliath
notes: The Elah Valley, where David defeated the Philistine giant Goliath.

name: Elam
meaning: Ancient kingdom east of Babylon; ally and enemy of Israel
notes: Elam, an ancient nation east of Babylon, at times an ally and at times an enemy of Israel.

name: Elath
meaning: Edomite port on the Red Sea; fortified by Judah
notes: Elath, an Edomite port on the Red Sea, was fortified by Judah during the reigns of Solomon and Uzziah.

name: Elealeh
meaning: Moabite city assigned to Reuben; later prophecies of destruction
notes: Elealeh, a Moabite city assigned to the tribe of Reuben, later featured in prophecies of Moab's destruction.

name: Elim
meaning: Desert oasis on Israel's journey from Egypt to Sinai
notes: Elim, a desert oasis where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to Mount Sinai.

name: Elkosh
meaning: Hometown of the prophet Nahum
notes: Elkosh, the hometown of the prophet Nahum, probably located in Judah.

name: Ellasar
meaning: Mesopotamian city-state; allied with Elam against Sodom and Gomorrah
notes: Ellasar, a Mesopotamian city-state whose king Arioch joined Chedorlaomer of Elam in battle against Sodom and Gomorrah.

name: Elon
meaning: City in the territory of Dan
notes: Elon, a city allotted to the tribe of Dan during the division of the Promised Land.

name: Elonbeth-hanan
meaning: City under the jurisdiction of Solomon's governor Ben-Deker
notes: Elonbeth-hanan, a city under the jurisdiction of Ben-Deker, one of Solomon's twelve governors.

name: El-paran
meaning: Wilderness area where the Horites were defeated by Chedorlaomer
notes: El-paran, a wilderness region where Chedorlaomer and his allies defeated the Horites during their campaign.

name: Eltekeh
meaning: City in Dan's territory; later given to the Levites
notes: Eltekeh, a city in Dan's territory that was later given to the Levites.

name: Eltekon
meaning: City in the hill country of Judah
notes: Eltekon, a city in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to Judah.

name: Eltolad
meaning: A town allotted to Judah and Simeon
notes: Eltolad, a town allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon in the Negev region.

name: Emek-keziz
meaning: Emek-keziz, town allotted to Benjamin
notes: Emek-keziz, a town within the territory allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.

name: Emmaus
meaning: Emmaus, village where Jesus appeared to two disciples after resurrection
notes: Emmaus, a village approximately seven miles from Jerusalem, where Jesus appeared to two disciples after His resurrection.

name: Enaim
meaning: Enaim, place where Tamar posed as a prostitute
notes: Enaim, the place where Tamar sat and posed as a prostitute to deceive Judah.

name: Enam
meaning: Enam, town allotted to Judah in the Shephelah
notes: Enam, a town in the Shephelah region, allotted to the tribe of Judah.

name: En-dor
meaning: Canaanite city; site of Saul's consultation with medium
notes: En-dor, a Canaanite city where Saul consulted a medium before his final battle with the Philistines.

name: Eneglaim
meaning: Place mentioned in Ezekiel's vision of restored Israel
notes: Eneglaim, a place mentioned in Ezekiel's vision of the restored land of Israel.

name: En-gannim
meaning: City in the lowlands of Judah
notes: En-gannim, a city in the lowlands of Judah, mentioned in the list of cities allotted to Judah.

name: En-gannim
meaning: Levitical city in Issachar's territory
notes: En-gannim (or Anem), a Levitical city in the territory of Issachar, given to the Gershonite Levites.

name: Engedi
meaning: Oasis in Judah; refuge for David; Chedorlaomer's victory
notes: Engedi (or Hazazon-tamar), an oasis in Judah where David sought refuge from Saul, also the site of Chedorlaomer's victory.

name: En-haddah
meaning: City allotted to the tribe of Issachar
notes: En-haddah, a city allotted to the tribe of Issachar during the division of the Promised Land.

name: En-hakkore
meaning: Spring that appeared after Samson's victory over the Philistines
notes: En-hakkore, the spring that God provided for Samson after his victory over the Philistines at Lehi.

name: En-hazor
meaning: City allotted to the tribe of Naphtali
notes: En-hazor, a city allotted to the tribe of Naphtali during the division of the Promised Land.

name: En-rogel
meaning: Spring near Jerusalem; associated with Adonijah's and David's kingships
notes: En-rogel, a spring near Jerusalem, was the site of Adonijah's attempt to become king and later served as a meeting place for David's supporters.

name: En-shemesh
meaning: Spring on the border between Judah and Benjamin
notes: En-shemesh, a spring on the border between the territories of Judah and Benjamin, near Jerusalem.

name: Ephah
meaning: Arabian tribe; known for their camels and dromedaries
notes: Ephah, an Arabian tribe known for their camels and dromedaries, mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy of nations coming to Jerusalem.

name: Ephes-dammim
meaning: Place where the Philistines and Israelites fought; Goliath's challenge
notes: Ephes-dammim (or Pas-dammim), the place where the Philistines and Israelites faced each other in battle, and where Goliath challenged the Israelites.

name: Ephesus
meaning: Major city in Asia Minor; important center for early Christianity
notes: Ephesus, a major city in Asia Minor, was an important center for early Christianity and the recipient of one of Paul's epistles.

name: Ephraim
meaning: City near the Judean wilderness; Jesus withdrew there
notes: Ephraim, a city near the Judean wilderness where Jesus withdrew after the raising of Lazarus.

name: Ephraim_Gate
meaning: Gate in Jerusalem's wall, broken down by King Jehoash
notes: The Ephraim Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall that was broken down by King Jehoash of Israel during his conflict with King Amaziah of Judah.

name: Ephron_Mount
meaning: Mountain on the border between Judah and Benjamin
notes: Mount Ephron, a mountain on the border between the territories of Judah and Benjamin, near Kiriath-jearim.

name: Erech
meaning: Ancient Mesopotamian city; part of Nimrod's kingdom
notes: Erech, an ancient Mesopotamian city that was part of Nimrod's kingdom and later inhabited by people who opposed the rebuilding of the Jerusalem Temple.

name: Esau_Mount
meaning: Mountainous region of Edom; judgment prophesied by Obadiah
notes: Mount Esau, the mountainous region of Edom, against which the prophet Obadiah declared God's judgment for their hostility toward Israel.

name: Esek
meaning: Well dug by Isaac's servants; named after quarrel
notes: Esek, a well dug by Isaac's servants, named after a quarrel with local herdsmen.

name: Eshan
meaning: City in the hill country of Judah
notes: Eshan, a city in the hill country of Judah, allotted to the tribe of Judah.

name: Eshcol_Valley
meaning: Valley where Israelite spies obtained a large cluster of grapes
notes: The Eshcol Valley, where the Israelite spies cut down a large cluster of grapes during their reconnaissance mission in Canaan.

name: Eshtaol
meaning: City allotted to Judah and Dan; associated with Samson
notes: Eshtaol, a city allotted to Judah and Dan, was the hometown of Samson and the starting point of the Danite migration.

name: Eshtemoa
meaning: Levitical city in Judah; received spoils from David's victory
notes: Eshtemoa (or Eshtemoh), a Levitical city in Judah, was the home of several individuals and received spoils from David's victory over the Amalekites.

name: Etam
meaning: Villages associated with Simeon; home of Judahite clan
notes: Etam, a village associated with the tribe of Simeon and the home of a Judahite clan.

name: Etam
meaning: City fortified by Rehoboam in Judah
notes: Etam, a city in Judah fortified by King Rehoboam after the division of the kingdom.

name: Etam
meaning: Cliff where Samson hid after defeating the Philistines
notes: Etam, the cliff where Samson hid after defeating the Philistines, located in Judah.

name: Etham
meaning: Wilderness area where Israelites camped during the Exodus
notes: Etham, a wilderness area on the edge of the desert where the Israelites camped during their journey from Egypt to the Promised Land.

name: Ether
meaning: City allotted to Judah and Simeon
notes: Ether, a city allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon in the Shephelah region.

name: Eth-kazin
meaning: Border town of Zebulun near Neah
notes: Eth-kazin, a border town of Zebulun located near Neah.

name: Euphrates
meaning: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land
notes: The Euphrates, a major river in the ancient Near East, often served as a boundary marker for the Promised Land and was the site of significant events in biblical history.

name: Ezel_Stone
meaning: Location where David and Jonathan planned to meet
notes: The Stone of Ezel, a location where David and Jonathan planned to meet and communicate secretly during David's flight from King Saul.

name: Ezem
meaning: City allotted to Judah and Simeon
notes: Ezem, a city allotted to the tribes of Judah and Simeon in the Negev region.

name: Ezion-geber
meaning: Israelite encampment; port city on Red Sea
notes: Ezion-geber, an Israelite encampment during the Exodus and later a port city on the Red Sea, known for its maritime trade and shipbuilding.

name: Fair_Havens
meaning: Harbor on Crete; Paul's ship stopped during journey to Rome
notes: Fair Havens, a harbor on the island of Crete where Paul's ship stopped during his journey to Rome.

name: Fish_Gate
meaning: Gate in Jerusalem's wall; rebuilt by Hassenaah during Nehemiah's time
notes: The Fish Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, was rebuilt by the sons of Hassenaah during Nehemiah's time and was a location of judgment and trade.

name: Forest_Ephraim
meaning: Location of the battle between David's forces and Absalom's army
notes: The Forest of Ephraim, where the battle between David's forces and Absalom's army took place during Absalom's rebellion.

name: Forum_of_Appius
meaning: Marketplace on Appian Way; Christians met Paul on journey to Rome
notes: The Forum of Appius, a marketplace on the Appian Way, where Christians from Rome met Paul during his journey to the city as a prisoner.

name: Foundation_Gate
meaning: Gate in Jerusalem's wall; location of Levite singers during coronation
notes: The Foundation Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, where a third of the Levite singers were positioned during the coronation of Joash.

name: Fountain_Gate
meaning: Gate in Jerusalem's wall; rebuilt by Shallun during Nehemiah's time
notes: The Fountain Gate, a gate in Jerusalem's wall, was rebuilt by Shallun during Nehemiah's time and was a location for processions and gatherings.

name: Gaash
meaning: Mountain in Ephraim; burial place of Joshua
notes: Gaash, a mountain in the region of Ephraim, was the burial place of Joshua and the homeland of two of David's mighty men.

name: Gabbatha
meaning: Raised stone platform in Jerusalem; location of Jesus' trial
notes: Gabbatha, also known as the Stone Pavement, was the location in Jerusalem where Pontius Pilate sat in judgment over Jesus.

name: Galatia
meaning: A region in Asia Minor, recipient of Paul's epistle.
notes: Galatia, a region in Asia Minor, was the recipient of Paul's epistle to the Galatians and was visited by Paul on his missionary journeys ( Act.16.6; 18:23; 1Co.16.1; Galatians 1:2; 3:1; 6:18; 2Ti.4.10; 1Pe.1.1 ).

name: Galilee
meaning: Region in northern Israel; key location in Jesus' ministry
notes: Galilee, a region in northern Israel, was a significant location in Jesus' life and ministry, as well as the homeland of many of his disciples.

name: Gallim
meaning: Town in Benjamin; home of Michal's husband Paltiel
notes: Gallim, a town in Benjamin, was the home of Paltiel, Michal's husband, and is mentioned in a prophecy of Isaiah.

name: Gamad
meaning: People group; defenders of the towers of Tyre
notes: The Gamad were a people group mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy as defenders of the towers of Tyre.

name: Gareb
meaning: A hill near Jerusalem
notes: Gareb, a hill mentioned in Jeremiah 31:39 , was located near Jerusalem and was to be included within the city's future boundaries.

name: Gath
meaning: Philistine city; home of Goliath; refuge for David
notes: Gath, one of the five major Philistine cities, was the hometown of Goliath and a place of refuge for David during his flight from Saul.

name: Gath-hepher
meaning: Town in Zebulun; hometown of prophet Jonah
notes: Gath-hepher, a town in the territory of Zebulun, was the hometown of the prophet Jonah.

name: Gath-rimmon
meaning: Levitical city in Dan and Manasseh
notes: Gath-rimmon, a Levitical city, was allotted to the Kohathite Levites within the territories of Dan and Manasseh.

name: Gaza
meaning: Philistine city; Samson's exploits; Philip's ministry
notes: Gaza, one of the five major Philistine cities, was the site of Samson's exploits and a place visited by Philip the evangelist in the early church.

name: Geba
meaning: A Levitical city in Benjamin
notes: Geba, a Levitical city in the territory of Benjamin, was located on the northern border of the kingdom of Judah ( Joshua 18:24; 1Ki.15.22 ).

name: Gebal
meaning: Phoenician city; skilled builders; allied against Israel
notes: Gebal, a Phoenician city known for its skilled builders, was allied against Israel and provided materials for Solomon's temple.

name: Gebim
meaning: Town in Benjamin; mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy
notes: Gebim, a town in Benjamin, is mentioned in Isaiah's prophecy describing the advance of the Assyrian army towards Jerusalem.

name: Gederah
meaning: Town in Judah; home of Baal-hanan and Jozabad
notes: Gederah, a town in Judah, was the home of Baal-hanan, one of David's overseers, and Jozabad, one of his mighty men.

name: Gederoth
meaning: Town in Judah; captured by Philistines during Ahaz's reign
notes: Gederoth, a town in Judah, was captured by the Philistines during the reign of King Ahaz.

name: Gederothaim
meaning: Town in Judah; mentioned in list of allotted cities
notes: Gederothaim, a town in Judah, is mentioned in the list of cities allotted to the tribe of Judah.

name: Gedor
meaning: Region where Simeonites sought pasture for their flocks
notes: Gedor, a region where some Simeonites went to find pasture for their flocks during the reign of King Hezekiah.

name: Gedor
meaning: Town in Judah; home of Judahite clan members
notes: Gedor (or Geder), a town in the hill country of Judah, was the home of several members of Judahite clans.

name: Ge-harashim
meaning: Valley of craftsmen; inhabited by Benjamites after the exile
notes: Ge-harashim, the Valley of Craftsmen, was inhabited by some Benjamites after the return from the Babylonian exile.

name: Gerar
meaning: Philistine city; Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech
notes: Gerar, a Philistine city, was the location of Abraham and Isaac's encounters with Abimelech and the site of a battle during King Asa's reign.

name: Gerasa
meaning: Region where Jesus healed a demon-possessed man
notes: Gerasa (or Gadara), a region southeast of the Sea of Galilee, was the location where Jesus healed a demon-possessed man.

name: Gerizim_Mount
meaning: Mountain in Samaria; site of blessings and Jotham's parable
notes: Mount Gerizim, a mountain in Samaria, was designated as the site for pronouncing blessings and was the location of Jotham's parable to the men of Shechem.

name: Geruth_Chimham
meaning: Lodging place near Bethlehem; refuge for Johanan's group
notes: Geruth Chimham, a lodging place near Bethlehem, served as a temporary refuge for Johanan and his group after the murder of Gedaliah.

name: Geshur
meaning: Aramean kingdom; Talmai's domain; refuge for Absalom
notes: Geshur, an Aramean kingdom ruled by Talmai, was the homeland of David's wife Maacah and a refuge for Absalom after he murdered his half-brother Amnon.

name: Gethsemane
meaning: Garden near Jerusalem; site of Jesus' prayer and arrest
notes: Gethsemane, a garden at the Mount of Olives, was the site where Jesus prayed and was arrested before his crucifixion.

name: Gezer
meaning: A Canaanite city, conquered by Joshua and later by David.
notes: Gezer, also known as Gob, was a Canaanite city conquered by Joshua and later by David, and it was fortified by Solomon ( Joshua 10:33; 12:12; 16:3, 10; 21:21; Judges 1:29; 2Sa.5.25; 21:18-19; 1Ki.9.15-17; 1Ch.6.67; 7:28; 14:16; 20:4, 10; 21:21; Judges 1:29; 2Sa.5.25; 21:18-19; 1Ki.9.15-17; 1Ch.6.67; 7:28; 14:16; 20:4 ).

name: Giah
meaning: Location near Gibeon where Joab and Abishai pursued Abner.
notes: Giah was a place near Gibeon where Joab and Abishai pursued Abner after the battle at the pool of Gibeon.

name: Gibbethon
meaning: A Levitical city in the territory of Dan.
notes: Gibbethon, a Levitical city in the territory of Dan, was the site of conflict during the reigns of Nadab and Baasha ( Joshua 19:44; 21:23; 1Ki.15.27; 16:15, 17 ).

name: Gibeah
meaning: A town in the hill country of Judah.
notes: Gibeah, a town in the hill country of Judah, was the hometown of Maacah, the mother of King Abijah ( Joshua 15:57; 2Ch.13.2 ).

name: Gibeah
meaning: A city of Benjamin, associated with Saul and atrocities.
notes: Gibeah, a city of Benjamin, was the hometown of Saul and the site of infamous atrocities during the time of the judges ( Judges 19-20; 1Sa.10.5, 10, 26; 15:34; Hosea 9:9; 10:9 ).

name: Gibeath-elohim
meaning: A place with a garrison of Philistines, near Gibeah.
notes: Gibeath-elohim, meaning "Hill of God," was a place near Gibeah where a garrison of Philistines was located ( 1Sa.10.5 ).

name: Gibeon
meaning: Hivite city that tricked Joshua into a peace treaty.
notes: Gibeon was a prominent Hivite city that deceived Joshua into making a peace treaty, and later became a Levitical city and site of worship.

name: Gidom
meaning: A place near Gibeah, associated with the Benjamite War.
notes: Gidom was a place near Gibeah where the Benjamites were pursued and defeated during the Benjamite War ( Judges 20:45 ).

name: Gihon
meaning: A river of Eden; a spring near Jerusalem.
notes: Gihon refers to both a river of Eden ( Genesis 2:13 ) and a spring near Jerusalem ( 1Ki.1.33, 38, 45; 2Ch.32.30; 33:14 ).

name: Gilboa
meaning: A mountain range where Saul and his sons died.
notes: Mount Gilboa was the site of a battle where Saul and his sons were killed by the Philistines ( 1Sa.28.4; 2Sa.1.21; 21:12 ).

name: Gilboa_Mount
meaning: A mountain range where Saul and his sons died.
notes: Mount Gilboa was the site where Saul and his sons were killed in battle against the Philistines ( 1Sa.31.1, 8; 2Sa.1.6; 1Ch.10.1, 8; Judges 7:3 ).

name: Gilead
meaning: Mountainous region east of Jordan; tribal territory and personal name.
notes: Gilead refers to a mountainous region east of the Jordan River, as well as being a personal name for several individuals in the Old Testament.

name: Gilgal
meaning: A place associated with the prophets Elijah and Elisha.
notes: Gilgal, a place associated with the prophets Elijah and Elisha, was the starting point of Elijah's final journey and the location of a prophetic community ( 2Ki.2.1; 4:38 ).

name: Gilgal
meaning: A significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan.
notes: Gilgal, also known as Geliloth, Beth-gilgal, or Gibeath-haaraloth, was a significant site during Israel's early history in Canaan, serving as a base for Joshua and a place of worship ( Deu.11.30; Joshua 4:19-20; 5:3,9-10; 14:6; Judges 2:1; 11:14-15; 15:12-33; Hosea 9:15 ).

name: Giloh
meaning: A city in Judah; home of Ahithophel, David's counselor.
notes: Giloh, also known as Gilo, was a city in Judah and the hometown of Ahithophel, David's counselor who later conspired with Absalom ( Joshua 15:51; 2Sa.15.12; 23:34 ).

name: Gimzo
meaning: A city in Judah captured by the Philistines.
notes: Gimzo was a city in the plain of Judah that was captured by the Philistines during the reign of Ahaz ( 2Ch.28.18 ).

name: Gittaim
meaning: Town where Beerothites fled; later inhabited by Benjamites.
notes: Gittaim was a town where the Beerothites fled and was later inhabited by the Benjamites after the Babylonian exile.

name: Goah
meaning: A place near Jerusalem, mentioned in a prophetic context.
notes: Goah was a place near Jerusalem, mentioned in the context of a prophetic description of the city's future restoration ( Jeremiah 31:39 ).

name: Gog
meaning: A symbolic enemy of God's people in prophetic literature.
notes: Gog is mentioned in the prophetic books of Ezekiel and Revelation as a symbolic enemy of God's people who will be defeated in the end times ( Ezk.38.2, 3, 14, 16, 18; 39:1, 11; Revelation 20:8 ).

name: Golan
meaning: A city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to Manasseh.
notes: Golan was a city of refuge in Bashan, allotted to the Levites of the family of Gershon and located in the territory of the half-tribe of Manasseh ( Deu.4.43; Joshua 20:8; 21:27; 1Ch.6.71 ).

name: Golgotha
meaning: The place where Jesus was crucified, meaning "Place of a Skull."
notes: Golgotha, also known as the Place of a Skull, was the site outside Jerusalem where Jesus was crucified ( Matthew 27:33; Mrk.15.22; Luke 23:33; Jhn.19.17 ).

name: Gomorrah
meaning: Wicked city destroyed by God along with Sodom.
notes: Gomorrah was a wicked city in the plain of Jordan that God destroyed with sulfur and fire, along with Sodom, due to their grave sins.

name: Goshen
meaning: A region in Egypt where the Israelites settled and prospered.
notes: Goshen was the region in Egypt where Jacob and his family settled during the time of Joseph, and where the Israelites lived and prospered until the Exodus ( Genesis 45:10; 46:28-29, 34; 47:1, 4, 6, 27; 50:8; Exodus 8:22; 9:26 ).

name: Goshen
meaning: A town and region in the hill country of Judah.
notes: Goshen was a town and region in the hill country of Judah, mentioned in the accounts of Joshua's conquests ( Joshua 10:41; 11:16; 15:51 ).

name: Gozan
meaning: A region in Mesopotamia where Israelite captives were deported.
notes: Gozan was a region in Mesopotamia where Israelite captives from the northern kingdom were deported by the Assyrians ( 2Ki.17.6; 18:11; 19:12; 1Ch.5.26; Isaiah 37:12 ).

name: Great_Sea
meaning: The Mediterranean Sea, the western boundary of the Promised Land.
notes: The Great Sea, also known as the Sea of the Philistines, refers to the Mediterranean Sea, which formed the western boundary of the Promised Land ( Numbers 34:6-7; Joshua 1:4; 9:1; 15:12, 47; 23:4; Ezk.47.10, 15, 19-20; 48:28; Exodus 23:31 ).

name: Greece
meaning: A nation and culture, often in opposition to Israel
notes: Greece (Javan), a nation and culture mentioned in both the Old and New Testaments.

name: Guard_Gate
meaning: A gate in Jerusalem's wall, likely the Muster Gate.
notes: The Guard Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's wall, mentioned in Nehemiah 12:39 , likely the same as the Muster Gate near the Temple.

name: Gur
meaning: A place near Ibleam where Ahaziah was wounded.
notes: Gur was a place near Ibleam where Ahaziah, king of Judah, was wounded by Jehu's men while fleeing ( 2Ki.9.27 ).

name: Gurbaal
meaning: A place inhabited by Arabians, attacked by Uzziah's army.
notes: Gurbaal was a place inhabited by Arabians, against whom Uzziah, king of Judah, waged war and prevailed ( 2Ch.26.7 ).

name: Habor
meaning: A river in Assyria where Israelite captives were settled.
notes: Habor was a river in Assyria along which the Israelite captives from the northern kingdom were settled by the Assyrians ( 2Ki.17.6; 18:11; 1Ch.5.26 ).

name: Hachilah
meaning: A hill in the Wilderness of Ziph, near David's hideout.
notes: Hachilah was a hill in the Wilderness of Ziph, where David hid from Saul and where the Ziphites revealed David's location to Saul ( 1Sa.23.19; 26:1, 3 ).

name: Hadad-rimmon
meaning: A place near Megiddo associated with mourning for Josiah.
notes: Hadad-rimmon was a place near Megiddo where a great lamentation was held for King Josiah, who was mortally wounded there.

name: Hadashah
meaning: A town in the Shephelah region of Judah.
notes: Hadashah was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah, located in the Shephelah region ( Joshua 15:37 ).

name: Hadid
meaning: A town in Benjamin, resettled after the Babylonian exile.
notes: Hadid was a town in Benjamin, whose inhabitants returned from the Babylonian exile and resettled in the town ( Ezra 2:33; Nehemiah 7:37; 11:34 ).

name: Hadrach
meaning: A region mentioned in a prophetic oracle of judgment.
notes: Hadrach was a region mentioned in a prophetic oracle of judgment, possibly located in Syria ( Zechariah 9:1 ).

name: Haeleph
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin.
notes: Haeleph was a town allotted to the tribe of Benjamin ( Joshua 18:28 ).

name: Halah
meaning: A place where Israelites were exiled by the Assyrians.
notes: Halah was one of the places where the Assyrians settled the exiled Israelites after conquering the Northern Kingdom.

name: Halak_Mount
meaning: A mountain marking the southern boundary of Joshua's conquests.
notes: Mount Halak was a mountain that marked the southern boundary of the territory conquered by Joshua ( Joshua 11:17; 12:7 ).

name: Halhul
meaning: A town in the hill country of Judah.
notes: Halhul was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah, located in the hill country ( Joshua 15:58 ).

name: Hali
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Asher.
notes: Hali was a town allotted to the tribe of Asher ( Joshua 19:25 ).

name: Hall_of_Judgment
meaning: A hall in Solomon's palace where he administered justice.
notes: The Hall of Judgment was a hall in Solomon's palace where he sat to judge and administer justice ( 1Ki.7.7 ).

name: Hall_of_Pillars
meaning: A porch with pillars in Solomon's palace.
notes: The Hall of Pillars was a porch in Solomon's palace, measuring fifty cubits long and thirty cubits wide, with a portico of pillars and a canopy.

name: Hall_of_the_Throne
meaning: Another name for the Hall of Judgment in Solomon's palace.
notes: The Hall of the Throne was another name for the Hall of Judgment in Solomon's palace, where he sat to administer justice ( 1Ki.7.7 ).

name: Ham
meaning: A place where Chedorlaomer defeated the Zuzim in battle.
notes: Ham was a place where Chedorlaomer and his allies defeated the Zuzim in battle during the war of the kings ( Genesis 14:5 ).

name: Hamath
meaning: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.
notes: Hamath, also known as Hamath Rabbah or Lebo-hamath, was a significant city and kingdom in Syria, frequently mentioned in the Bible as a reference point for the northern border of Israel and in the context of political and military events ( Num.13:21; Judges 3:3; 2Ki.14.25, 28; Jeremiah 39:5; 49:23; 52:9, 27 ).

name: Hammath
meaning: A fortified city and Levitical town in Naphtali.
notes: Hammath, also known as Hammoth-dor or Hammon, was a fortified city in Naphtali allotted to the Levites ( Joshua 19:35; 21:32; 19:28; 1Ch.6.76 ).

name: Hamonah
meaning: A city in Ezekiel's vision, meaning "multitude" or "horde."
notes: Hamonah is a city mentioned in Ezekiel's vision ( Ezk.39.16 ), its name meaning "multitude" or "horde," likely referring to the burial place of Gog's army.

name: Hamon-gog_Valley
meaning: A valley where Gog and his army will be buried.
notes: The Valley of Hamon-gog is the place where Gog and his army will be buried after their defeat, as prophesied by Ezekiel ( Ezk.39.11, 15 ).

name: Hanes
meaning: An Egyptian city mentioned in a prophecy against Judah.
notes: Hanes was an Egyptian city to which Judah sent envoys, as mentioned in a prophecy by Isaiah ( Isaiah 30:4 ).

name: Hannathon
meaning: A border town in the territory of Zebulun.
notes: Hannathon was a border town in the territory allotted to the tribe of Zebulun ( Joshua 19:14 ).

name: Hara
meaning: A place where Israelite tribes were exiled by Tiglath-pileser.
notes: Hara was a place, possibly in Media, where the Reubenites, Gadites, and half-tribe of Manasseh were exiled by Tiglath-pileser, king of Assyria ( 1Ch.5.26 ).

name: Haradah
meaning: A desert campsite during Israel's journey from Egypt.
notes: Haradah was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their journey through the wilderness after leaving Egypt.

name: Haran
meaning: A city in Mesopotamia, associated with Abraham and his family.
notes: Haran was a city in Mesopotamia where Abraham and his family settled after leaving Ur, and from where Abraham later departed for Canaan ( Genesis 11:31-32; 12:4-5; 27:43; 28:10; 29:4; Act.7.2, 4 ).

name: Harmon
meaning: A place mentioned in Amos's prophecy against Israel.
notes: Harmon is a place mentioned in Amos's prophecy, possibly referring to the destination of the exiled Israelites ( Amo.4.3 ).

name: Harod
meaning: A spring near where Gideon gathered his army.
notes: Harod was a spring near the hill of Moreh, where Gideon gathered his army before battling the Midianites ( Judges 7:1 ).

name: Harosheth-hagoyim
meaning: Canaanite city ruled by Sisera
notes: Harosheth-hagoyim was a Canaanite city that served as the base for Sisera, the commander of King Jabin's army ( Judg 4:2 ).

name: Hashmonah
meaning: A desert campsite during Israel's journey from Egypt.
notes: Hashmonah was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings after leaving Egypt.

name: Hauran
meaning: Region east of the Sea of Galilee
notes: Hauran was a fertile region located east of the Sea of Galilee, mentioned as part of Israel's future boundaries ( Ezk.47.16,18 ).

name: Havilah
meaning: Land near Eden with gold, bdellium, and onyx
notes: Havilah was a land mentioned in the description of Eden, known for its pure gold, aromatic resin (bdellium), and onyx stone ( Gen.2.11-12 ).

name: Havilah
meaning: Region inhabited by Ishmaelites, raided by Saul
notes: Havilah was a region inhabited by the descendants of Ishmael ( Gen.25.18 ), which was later raided by King Saul during his campaign against the Amalekites ( 1Sa.15.7 ).

name: Havvoth-jair
meaning: Villages in Gilead captured by Jair
notes: Havvoth-jair were villages in Gilead captured by Jair, a leader from the tribe of Manasseh, during the Israelite conquest of the region ( Num.32.41; Deut 3:14; Judg 10:4; 1Ch.2.23 ).

name: Hazar-addar
meaning: A town on the southern border of Canaan.
notes: Hazar-addar was a town on the southern border of Canaan, mentioned in the description of the land's boundaries.

name: Hazar-enan
meaning: Town on the northern border of Israel
notes: Hazar-enan was a town located on the northern border of the Promised Land (Num.34.9-10) and the future inheritance of the tribe of Dan ( Ezk.48.1 ).

name: Hazar-gaddah
meaning: Town allotted to the tribe of Judah
notes: Hazar-gaddah was a town in the Negev region, allotted to the tribe of Judah during the division of the Promised Land ( Josh 15:27 ).

name: Hazar-shual
meaning: Town allotted to Judah and Simeon
notes: Hazar-shual was a town in the Negev allotted to Judah ( Josh 15:28 ), later given to the tribe of Simeon ( Josh 19:3; 1Ch.4.28 ), and inhabited by Jews after the Babylonian exile ( Neh.11.27 ).

name: Hazar-susah
meaning: Town allotted to the tribe of Simeon
notes: Hazar-susah was a town in the Negev region, allotted to the tribe of Simeon during the division of the Promised Land ( Josh 19:5 ).

name: Hazar-susim
meaning: A town allotted to the tribe of Simeon.
notes: Hazar-susim was a town allotted to the tribe of Simeon, mentioned in the list of their cities in 1 Chronicles.

name: Hazer-hatticon
meaning: Place on the ideal border of Israel
notes: Hazer-hatticon, meaning "the middle village," was a place named on the ideal border of Israel in Ezekiel's vision ( Ezk.47.16 ), likely identical to Hazar-enan.

name: Hazerim
meaning: Settlements inhabited by the Avvim
notes: Hazerim, meaning "villages," refers to the settlements inhabited by the Avvim, a people group dispossessed by the Caphtorim ( Deut 2:23 ).

name: Hazeroth
meaning: Israelite encampment during the wilderness wanderings
notes: Hazeroth was one of the places where the Israelites camped during their wilderness wanderings, mentioned in the context of Moses' leadership challenges ( Num.11.35; 12:16; 33:17-18; Deut 1:1 ).

name: Hazor
meaning: Region in Arabia, possibly Ituraea, threatened by Nebuchadnezzar
notes: Hazor refers to a region in Arabia, possibly Ituraea, against which Nebuchadnezzar, king of Babylon, launched a military campaign ( Jer.49.28,30,33 ).

name: Hazor
meaning: Major Canaanite city conquered by Joshua
notes: Hazor was a major Canaanite city, whose king Jabin led a coalition against Israel; it was captured and destroyed by Joshua ( Josh 11:1,10-11,13 ), later oppressing Israel before being defeated by Deborah and Barak ( Judg 4:2,17 ).

name: Hazor
meaning: A town in the southland of Judah.
notes: Hazor was a town allotted to the tribe of Judah in the Negev region.

name: Hazor
meaning: Town in the Negev region of Judah
notes: Hazor was a town in the Negev region, part of the territory allotted to the tribe of Judah ( Josh 15:23 ).

name: Hazor
meaning: Town resettled by Benjamites after the Babylonian exile
notes: Hazor was a town resettled by the Benjamites after their return from the Babylonian exile ( Neh.11.33 ).

name: Hazor-hadattah
meaning: Town in the Negev region of Judah
notes: Hazor-hadattah, meaning "New Hazor," was a town in the Negev region, part of the territory allotted to the tribe of Judah ( Josh 15:25 ).

name: Hebron
meaning: An important city in Judah; burial place of patriarchs.
notes: Hebron, also known as Kiriath-arba, was a significant city in Judah, associated with the patriarchs Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, and later became a Levitical city and a city of refuge.

name: Hebron_Valley
meaning: Valley near Hebron where Joseph sought his brothers
notes: The Hebron Valley was the location where Joseph was sent by his father, Jacob, to check on his brothers who were pasturing their flocks near Shechem ( Gen.37.14 ).

name: Helam
meaning: Place where David defeated the Arameans
notes: Helam was the location of a battle between David's forces and the Arameans, where David defeated Hadadezer, king of Zobah, and his allies ( 2Sa.10.16-17 ).

name: Helbah
meaning: Canaanite town not conquered by the tribe of Asher
notes: Helbah was a Canaanite town that the tribe of Asher failed to conquer during the period of the judges ( Judg 1:31 ).

name: Helbon
meaning: City known for its fine wine
notes: Helbon was a city mentioned in Ezk.27.18 as a trading partner of Tyre, known for its fine wine.

name: Helech
meaning: A place or people mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy.
notes: Helech was either a place, possibly in Cilicia, or a term referring to the army of Tyre, mentioned in Ezekiel's prophecy against Tyre.

name: Heleph
meaning: Border town of Naphtali
notes: Heleph was a town marking the border of the territory allocated to the tribe of Naphtali ( Josh 19:33 ).
